title: Training vs Blue-Eyes
summary: Blue-Eyes builds want to cheat out big Dragons (Ultimate, Spirit, Tyrant) and overwhelm with size plus disruption. Slow them before the board sticks; do not race blindly into a 3000+ body with omni-negates up.
winConditions: Break or prevent their first big summon so they spend resources rebuilding
Win through grind if you can out-resource ritual/fusion lines
OTK only when their disruption is spent
keyCardsRespect: Blue-Eyes Alternative / Jet — free specials that start plays
Maiden / Sage / Dictator — search and setup pieces
Blue-Eyes Ultimate / Spirit Dragon — board anchors
True Light — continuous recursion and protection lines
keyCardsNegate: The search that finds Alternative or ritual package
The fusion/ritual spell that completes the boss
True Light when it would recover a full turn

tips.title: Size vs interaction
tips.body: High ATK alone is not the win—track if they still have a negate or float after combat.

tips.title: GY hate
tips.body: Some Blue-Eyes lines reuse GY Dragons. Banishing a key body can stall a turn.

tips.title: Backrow
tips.body: Probe for True Light / Infinite Impermanence before committing your only breakers.

handtrapGuidance: Ash the search that completes the engine, not every optional dig.
Imperm on the sticky extender or on Spirit when it would negate your only out.
Nibiru is strong if they summon many times without a negate up.
commonMistakes: Crashing into a bigger Dragon without an out
Ashing a bait search and letting the real combo resolve
Ignoring True Light until they have already recovered
